facts.text: I am looking for new vegan dessert recipes to try out.
I am interested in vegan cheesecake, but I have already tried it.
I want recipes for vegan chocolate truffles.
I want other vegan chocolate recipes that do not require a blender or food processor.
I want the best way to store fudge to keep it fresh for a longer period.
I want the best way to melt vegan chocolate chips for truffles and fudge recipes.
I want to know whether I can use the microwave to melt vegan chocolate chips or whether a double boiler is better.
I want tips on how to temper chocolate for truffles.
I want the truffles to have a nice, smooth coating.
